messages:
amelie: Quick heads-up — we just pushed a targeted hotfix to the Private/on-prem installer (v2.3.1) that fixes an audit-log rotation and KMS integration edge-case reported by a customer earlier this week. Please read the short rollout plan below.

sanjay: Nice, what exactly was failing?

amelie: The issue: in air-gapped installs with HSM-backed KMS, long-running streaming jobs could cause the local audit log to exceed configured rotation limits and then stop accepting writes, which in turn caused the telemetry agent to back off and the healthcheck to report intermittent failures. The fix ensures the audit writer pre-allocates rotation slots and retries with exponential backoff instead of dropping writes.

elaine: Is this a compliance severity? Do we need to notify affected customers? :warning:

kia: From Legal/Compliance: we recommend proactive notification for customers who opt into audit-log shipping to our S3-compatible endpoint or have managed KMS integration. We'll provide a short advisory template.

amelie: Agreed. Action list: 1) Publish advisory to status.redwood.ai and customer-comms by EOD. 2) Backport patch to on-prem v2.2 branch for customers still on that train. 3) Ops to run a rolling canary in Dedicated and one private customer staging env. 4) Engineering to attach postmortem snippets for the KB.

mike: Ops note — canary scheduled now. ops-bot, please run the canary job and post results here.

ops-bot: deploy:canary triggered for private-installer:v2.3.1 -> staging-priv-1. Estimated 8m. Logs: https://internal.redwood/devops/canary/1769004500

ops-bot: deploy:canary completed. Result: PASS. 3/3 smoke checks. Latency and health stable.

sanjay: I pushed the patch to the v2.2-backport branch and opened PR #4287. The change is small (audit_writer: add prealloc + retry loop). CI green.

amelie: Thanks. Please also add a one-line migration note for customers running custom log-rotate values — default behavior remains unchanged but we recommend bumping rotation threshold if they have >48h streaming workloads.

kia: Draft advisory ready for review: "Redwood Private/on-prem: audit-log rotation fix (v2.3.1). Impact: possible dropped audit logs in specific HSM/KMS configs. Mitigation: upgrade to v2.3.1, or apply manual rotation tweak. Contact support for assisted upgrades."

elaine: Can we include an ISO/SOC callout? The important part: no unauthorized access occurred; this is durability/availability class only.

security-bot: security:incident-assessment completed. Classification: non-breach availability incident. No sensitive material exfiltrated.

mike: Ops will start a scheduled customer outreach for the 6 customers we flagged as using HSM + air-gapped. One support engineer will handle assisted upgrades next week.

amelie: Post-upgrade validation script for customers (run as root on control-plane node):
```
# validate audit writer
sudo /opt/redwood/bin/rwctl validate-audit --check-rotation --kms-status
```
Please paste results to the support ticket when you assist a customer.

sanjay: Also added internal migration playbook steps to the KB: rollback, forced-rotate, and manual KV sync for customers with slow networks.

kia: Communication plan approved. I'll send the advisory + suggested support replies in #customer-success.

amelie: Final: releasing v2.3.1 images to the private packages repo in 30m. Tags: private-installer:v2.3.1, runtime:v1.14.2. Watch for any post-deploy regressions and report in this thread. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: repo:publish private-installer:v2.3.1 -> packages.redwood/private 1769005730

mike: Noted. I'll monitor the first 4 customer upgrades tomorrow and loop back with metrics.

amelie: Thanks everyone. Short and pragmatic — we should be able to close the advisory after 48h of no regressions.

elaine: Thanks — appreciate the quick turn on this.
